app.tagline: Turn your GitHub commits into Odoo timesheets.

auth.confirmEmail: Confirm {{email}} to finish creating your account.

settings.title: Connections
settings.description: Your GitHub token and Odoo API keys are encrypted before they're stored, and never sent back to your browser.
settings.savedDescription: Your credentials were checked and stored encrypted.
settings.storedSecret: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Your commits are read with a personal access token.
github.tokenHint: Classic token with the repo scope, or a fine-grained token with read access to Contents and Metadata.
github.otherEmailsHint: Optional. Add the email of your local Git config when it isn't linked to your GitHub account, separated by commas.

odoo.title: Odoo instance {{index}}
odoo.descriptionPrimary: Tasks are looked up here first.
odoo.descriptionSecondary: Optional. Searched when a task isn't found in instance 1.
odoo.name: Name
odoo.apiKeyHint: In Odoo: Preferences, Account Security, New API Key. A password also works when two-factor authentication is off.

setup.title: Connect your accounts
setup.description: Pointage reads your commits with your GitHub token and logs your timesheets with your Odoo login and API key.

period.label: Period
period.pickFirstDay: Pick the first day, then the last day.
period.tooLong: The period can't be longer than a year.

timesheet.subtitle: Your commits of the period become timesheet lines, matched to their Odoo task.
timesheet.emptyDescription: Fetch your GitHub commits for the period, or paste them. Each one becomes a timesheet line, matched to its Odoo task through the reference in the message.
timesheet.loggedThatDayHint: You already logged time on this task that day in Odoo. Check before submitting.
timesheet.manualTaskHint: Task picked by hand: checking the line again keeps it.
timesheet.ticketLine: Time is logged on this helpdesk ticket

status.noTaskReference: The commit message has no task reference.
status.taskNotFound: Task {{taskRef}} wasn't found in your Odoo instances.
status.alreadyLogged: This line is already in Odoo with the same description.
status.noOdooResult: Odoo didn't return a result for this line.

pasteDialog.title: Paste commits
pasteDialog.description: One commit per line, or the output of git log. Merge commits and duplicates are skipped.
pasteDialog.noTime: No time pasted for this commit
pasteDialog.timeHint: To keep each commit's time, paste it before the message (14:32 [03-500] …) or use git log --date=iso.

notifications.fetchError: Couldn't fetch your commits from GitHub
notifications.taskNotFoundHint: Check the reference, or that you have access to the task.
notifications.skippedHint: Merge commits and empty lines are skipped.

kanban.title: My tasks
kanban.subtitle: The Odoo tasks and helpdesk tickets assigned to you, by stage.
kanban.emptyTitle: No tasks or tickets assigned to you
kanban.emptyDescription: Tasks and open helpdesk tickets assigned to you in your Odoo instances show up here, grouped by stage.
kanban.noMatchHint: Try another search, or show all instances.
kanban.truncated: Only your 1,000 most important tasks per instance are shown.
kanban.noProject: This task has no project, so time can't be logged on it.
kanban.ticketsTruncated: Only your 200 most important open tickets per instance are shown.

history.subtitle: The time you logged in Odoo over the period.
history.truncated: Only the 2,000 most recent lines per instance are shown. Pick a shorter period to see them all.
history.chartCaption: Hours per day. The dashed line is the {{target}} workday.
history.emptyTitle: No time logged in this period
history.emptyDescription: Pick another period, or log time from the timesheet or the Kanban board.
history.noMatchHint: Try another search, or show all instances.

grid.caption: Hours per task and per day
grid.missingDay: Nothing logged on this working day
grid.tooLong: The grid shows up to {{count}} days. Pick a shorter period, or use the list.

history.locked: Validated in Odoo: it can't be changed anymore.

deleteTimesheet.title: Delete this timesheet from Odoo?
deleteTimesheet.description: The {{hours}} logged on {{date}} will be removed from Odoo. This can't be undone.
deleteTimesheet.backInList: The {{hours}} line stays in your list, ready to submit again.

dayLoad.checking: Checking what this day already holds in Odoo
dayLoad.nothingYet: Nothing logged in Odoo on this day yet.
dayLoad.already: Already logged that day: {{day}}, including {{task}} on this task.
dayLoad.duplicate: A line with the same description already exists on this task that day.
dayLoad.tooLong: With this line, the day would reach {{total}} (more than {{limit}}).
dayLoad.alreadyTicket: Already logged that day: {{day}}, including {{task}} on this ticket.
dayLoad.duplicateTicket: A line with the same description already exists on this ticket that day.

completeDay.title: Complete the day
completeDay.description: {{date}} is {{hours}} short of a full day. Pick the task to log them on.

estimate.hint: Spreads an 8 h workday over each day's lines to submit, by the time between commits. Hours you typed and lines already in Odoo stay as they are.
estimate.doneHint: Lines are estimated from the time between commits. Adjust any of them: your value will be kept.

tasks.title: Tasks and tickets
tasks.subtitle: Find any Odoo task or helpdesk ticket, assigned to you or not, and log time on it.
tasks.searchTasksHint: Type at least 2 characters: a name ("Daily"), a reference ("01-501"), a project, or an ID ("#18486"). Tasks assigned to someone else are found too.
tasks.searchTicketsHint: Type at least 2 characters of a title, a reference or an ID.
tasks.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, try a shorter search, or show all instances.
tasks.truncated: Only the first 50 results per instance are shown. Refine the search to find the others.
tasks.ticketNotLoggable: Time can't be logged on this ticket: its helpdesk team doesn't track timesheets, or has no project for them.
tasks.helpdeskMissing: No Helpdesk app on your instances
tasks.helpdeskMissingHint: Tickets appear here when the Helpdesk app is installed on one of your Odoo instances.
tasks.noOpenTickets: No open ticket assigned to you
tasks.noOpenTicketsHint: Switch to all open tickets to find one assigned to someone else.

assignTask.title: Pick the task
assignTask.description: Choose the instance, then the project task or the helpdesk ticket to log this commit on.
assignTask.noProjects: No project accepts timesheets in this instance.
assignTask.projectsTruncated: Only the first 1,000 projects are listed. Search to narrow them down.
assignTask.noTasks: This project has no active task.
assignTask.tasksTruncated: Only the 500 latest tasks are listed. Type at least 2 characters to search all of them.
assignTask.applyToOthers_one: Also use it for the other line without a task that has the reference {{taskRef}}
assignTask.applyToOthers_other: Also use it for the {{count}} other lines without a task that have the reference {{taskRef}}
assignTask.checkError: The task is set, but Odoo couldn't be checked for time already logged
assignTask.searchTicket: Search a ticket, a reference (HT…) or an #ID
assignTask.myTicketsHint: Your open tickets. Type at least 2 characters to search every open ticket.
assignTask.ticketsTruncated: Only the first results are listed: refine the search.
assignTask.noTickets: You have no open ticket on this instance. Type at least 2 characters to search every open ticket.
assignTask.noHelpdesk: The Helpdesk app isn't installed on this instance.
assignTask.ticketNotLoggable: Time can't be logged on this ticket: its helpdesk team has no timesheet project.
